scope: integrated ASTRA/ASTRUM evidence and full regression for Gates61--68
claim_boundary: Gates61--68 form a reproducible ASTRA/ASTRUM block for total-self-energy accounting, three-term lesser reconstruction, exact charge/spin validation, grid/lead controls, closed Corbino channels, persistent separation, and explicit topology criteria.
